description: Extends carbon charge suspension for Saskatoon Light & Power customers until December 31, 2026.

chips.text: Staff set an end date for the pause for administrative reasons, not policy.
City Solicitor's department flagged issues with a bylaw having no end date for the pause.
Administration promises options to avoid mill rate impact if the pause causes a deficit.

description: Committee recommends increasing organics facility budget to $30.5 million, federally funded.
Exempts facility's receiving hall from green building standards.
Facility will process 40,000 tons annually, opening 2027.

chips.text: Mayor questioned higher costs; staff cited contractor unfamiliarity and risk.
Taxpayers save $1 million annually compared to outsourcing organics processing.
Federal funding requires greenhouse gas mitigation measures for the facility.
Staff will revise tendering process to reduce project costs.

description: Diversity committee allocated $15,100 for community initiatives.
Updated cultural diversity policy and Living in Harmony awards.

chips.text: Committee focuses on anti-racism, anti-oppression, and accessibility.
